title: siaf-darkening: Analysis code for Arctic sea ice darkening SIAF decomposition
description: Analysis code for 'Darkening of surviving Arctic sea ice contributes one third of the sea ice albedo feedback' (Rotondo et al.). Decomposes the Arctic sea ice albedo feedback (SIAF) into area-loss and ice-darkening components across satellite records (CLARA-A3, APP-x, NSIDC CDR) and 378 CMIP6 historical ensemble members using the APRP radiative sensitivity framework.
